question:
List all the frame styles and cards Allen Williams worked on and find any banned cards if there are any.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: frame styles refers to frameVersion; cards Allen Williams worked on refers to artist = 'Allen Williams'; banned cards refers to status = 'Banned'

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.XCL_002 AS frame_style,
    c.XCL_003 AS card_name,
    l.XCL_085 AS legality
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
WHERE c.XCL_004 = 'Allen Williams'
ORDER BY c.XCL_002, c.XCL_003

FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN legalities l ON l.XCL_086 = c.XCL_072
WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'Allen Williams'
ORDER BY c.XCL_002, c.XCL_019;
